title: Forest Floor Letters
hook: The forest floor holds stories under every tree.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: detailed but simple 3D forest-floor storybook, mushrooms leaves logs, muted greens and golds, uncluttered subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child kneeling at ground level and following connections from leaf litter into roots, water and underbrush
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: return attention to the shared ground beneath very different forest things
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: low gentle 6/8 with descending-to-rising phrase shapes
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written ecological close-ups; ground relation and physical layer matter more than decorative rhyme
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: ground-layer cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe close-up gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. wood-flute or pizzicato leaf answers between target phrases
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: wood-flute or pizzicato leaf answers between target phrases
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn the forest floor into a layered living system: seed, litter, fungus, insects, roots, stones, underbrush and visiting animals all share the same ground without reducing the song to a taxonomy list.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A kneeling observer reads the forest from ground level upward; recurring language uses under, through, beneath, litter, root, damp, layer and rise.
semanticArc: discover small life and damp growth
rise from underbrush toward birds and canopy
forbiddenGenericLanguage: leaves and logs are fun to see
forest floor for you and me
